finalText:
**Migrated 36 calls across 12 files.** All now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

Left `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js` alone. Its header says do not edit, since upgrades overwrite it. Two `db.query` calls remain there.

`cache.query` is a different object. Untouched.

No tests in the repo. `node --check` passes on every file.

Next: drop `db.query` from [lib/db.js:13](lib/db.js:13) once `vendor` is handled.
